name: Forgejo
tagline: Lightweight Git forge: repositories, issues, pull requests and CI.
description: Forgejo hosts your Git repositories with issues, pull requests, a wiki, packages and Actions, in a light and fast service run by a community.
postInstall: Open it: the first page sets it up. Keep SQLite, set the server address to the one you use to reach it, and create the administrator account at the bottom.
Clone over SSH on the SSH port published at install.
